findings.title: Break condition is broader than a bad fileno
findings.body: The break matches OSError, TypeError, or ValueError anywhere in the loop body, not only select() on a bad file descriptor. One transient error of those types ends monitoring where the old code would have retried.

findings.title: Monitor exit shares the transient error counter
findings.body: When the monitor breaks, the process is no longer watched. The signal is one log line and the same errors_count increment used for a retryable error.

findings.title: The new test covers only the break path
findings.body: test_monitor_process_stops_when_stdout_is_not_selectable uses a Mock stdout and a 30-minute inactivity timeout. It does not assert that other exceptions still sleep and retry.
